2:rkiewh.text: The city becomes a map of missions: glowing icons mark the subway station ahead and the Lab as a stop along the way.

4:1k5ekny.text: In the subway, a punk finds a giant Kaiju eye on the platform. {teammate} shouts at him not to touch it, but he does what he wants, and the eye's power floods into him. The team beats him, and {teammate} lays out the choice: recruit him, or study his DNA and take his power, which would kill him. {player} recruits Punk Guy.

4:37o6hz.text: In the subway, a punk finds a giant Kaiju eye on the platform. {teammate} shouts at him not to touch it, but he does what he wants, and the eye's power floods into him. The team beats him, and {teammate} lays out the choice: recruit him, or study his DNA and take his power, which would kill him. {player} terminates Punk Guy and takes his power.

0:pqmc5d.text: Kaiju City sits on a peninsula, and Kaiju are coming in from the sea. {player} and {teammate}, two cyborg soldiers rebuilt by the Lab, get the Agent's call over the radio: protect the Peninsula. {teammate} runs in beside {player} as the first wave wades ashore, and the two hold the line together.

1:18xgh4n.text: The morning after, downtown is a cleanup zone: severed Kaiju parts lie in the street while hazmat crews sweep around them. The Agent praises the team's work, but warns that the parts are toxic: one touch and you're changed for good. Bystanders are gathering around a fallen part at the West Rapid Transit station, and he sends the team there, with a stop at the Lab if they want to swap abilities. The scientists have a new one ready: Teleport. A hazmat worker, fed up with his job, may tag along.

3:1qkqpx.section: The Lab (a stop on any map walk)
3:1qkqpx.text: At the Lab, the Agent welcomes the team. Asked about the specimen tanks, he gets nervous and waves them off as 'R&D into cloning... nerd stuff.' Here the team can change their powers, and dip in a vat to change their glow, to a tech's cheerful 'Looking good!'

5:13eqz9x.text: Back on the radio, the Agent reports that Punk Guy finished re-education and works for them now, mohawk and all. Then sonar picks up a second wave of Kaiju, bigger than the first, and the team holds the Peninsula again.

5:13ra2kl.text: Back on the radio, the Agent calls Punk Guy's death 'cold, but clean.' Then sonar picks up a second wave of Kaiju, bigger than the first, and the team holds the Peninsula again.

6:d8mtgh.text: The Agent tells the two they're holding the city together. {teammate} notices the Kaiju are coming faster than they used to; the Agent answers with numbers, praising {player}'s {power} power, and keeps the bigger questions 'above your pay grade.' He sends them to the Cemetery district, where Kaiju parts are falling onto rooftops, and hints that Dispel will come in handy.

7:niambs.text: On a rooftop cemetery, a young woman hears her ancestors calling from the graves, angry, urging her to touch the giant Kaiju head that landed there. {teammate} can't stop her. As Ghost Girl she summons rings of ghosts, rising again each time she's beaten. Facing another choice, {teammate} notes the last one joined the crew. {player} recruits Ghost Girl too.

7:1wj9w4s.text: On a rooftop cemetery, a young woman hears her ancestors calling from the graves, angry, urging her to touch the giant Kaiju head that landed there. {teammate} can't stop her. As Ghost Girl she summons rings of ghosts, rising again each time she's beaten. {teammate} remembers that last time they took the power for themselves; this time {player} recruits Ghost Girl.

7:e8b769.text: On a rooftop cemetery, a young woman hears her ancestors calling from the graves, angry, urging her to touch the giant Kaiju head that landed there. {teammate} can't stop her. As Ghost Girl she summons rings of ghosts, rising again each time she's beaten. {teammate} notes the last one joined the crew, but this time {player} terminates Ghost Girl and takes her power.

7:1f2o1j1.text: On a rooftop cemetery, a young woman hears her ancestors calling from the graves, angry, urging her to touch the giant Kaiju head that landed there. {teammate} can't stop her. As Ghost Girl she summons rings of ghosts, rising again each time she's beaten. As with Punk Guy, {player} terminates her and takes her power.

8:8ct7f2.text: The Agent reports Ghost Girl is through re-education: her powers are unlike anything on file, but they drain her health, and she may need a babysitter. She cuts in on the line herself to say she doesn't, to the Agent's surprise. Then the biggest wave yet hits the Peninsula.

8:cg7ek9.text: The Agent reports Ghost Girl is 'in the ground. Fitting, for that address.' Then the biggest wave yet hits the Peninsula.

9:1jrebby.text: The radar goes quiet and the mayor sends his thanks, but {teammate} knows quiet never lasts. Asked whether anyone is looking into all these Kaiju parts, the Agent jokes that it's the team's job. Severed parts have crashed into the Aquarium, and despite their track record, he sends the two to keep anyone from touching them.

10:1b7f92d.text: At the Aquarium, a worker convinced she's a mermaid touches a giant Kaiju tongue before {teammate} can stop her. When beaten down, she screams 'Stop!!!', shattering the tanks and flooding the hall, then sends her sea creatures after the team while she heals upstairs. {teammate} assumes they'll recruit her like the others, and {player} does.

10:167hswc.text: At the Aquarium, a worker convinced she's a mermaid touches a giant Kaiju tongue before {teammate} can stop her. When beaten down, she screams 'Stop!!!', shattering the tanks and flooding the hall, then sends her sea creatures after the team while she heals upstairs. Having both recruited and terminated before, {teammate} leaves it to {player}, who recruits the Aquarium Worker.

10:1fnapqs.text: At the Aquarium, a worker convinced she's a mermaid touches a giant Kaiju tongue before {teammate} can stop her. When beaten down, she screams 'Stop!!!', shattering the tanks and flooding the hall, then sends her sea creatures after the team while she heals upstairs. {teammate} points out it's only ever been the two of them, and {player} starts a crew by recruiting the Aquarium Worker.

10:14sksgu.text: At the Aquarium, a worker convinced she's a mermaid touches a giant Kaiju tongue before {teammate} can stop her. When beaten down, she screams 'Stop!!!', shattering the tanks and flooding the hall, then sends her sea creatures after the team while she heals upstairs. {teammate} assumes they'll recruit her like the others, but {player} terminates her and takes her power.

10:6dtwp3.text: At the Aquarium, a worker convinced she's a mermaid touches a giant Kaiju tongue before {teammate} can stop her. When beaten down, she screams 'Stop!!!', shattering the tanks and flooding the hall, then sends her sea creatures after the team while she heals upstairs. Having both recruited and terminated before, {teammate} leaves it to {player}, who terminates her and harvests her power.

10:1j6rgdr.text: At the Aquarium, a worker convinced she's a mermaid touches a giant Kaiju tongue before {teammate} can stop her. When beaten down, she screams 'Stop!!!', shattering the tanks and flooding the hall, then sends her sea creatures after the team while she heals upstairs. {teammate} notes it's only ever been the two of them, and {player} terminates her like the others.

11:e8ps08.text: The Aquarium Worker is in re-education, still sure she's a mermaid, and the lab techs love her. Then the call comes: Kaiju on every approach, everything they've got. The team holds the Peninsula whatever it takes.

11:gc1hq.text: The Agent reports the mermaid 'off the board,' with the Aquarium asking who pays for the repairs. Then the call comes: Kaiju on every approach, everything they've got. The team holds the Peninsula whatever it takes.

12:1wvhhbf.text: With the last wave down, the Agent orders the team to the Lab on the double: the scientists have cooked up something special for them.

13:1omjuip.text: The Lab is quiet, and the Agent isn't there. {teammate} suggests looking for him, but first, choosing powers: who knows when they'll get another chance.

14:1rjup0l.text: The Agent finds them, thanks the team, and tells them they're no longer needed: clones of himself step out of the tanks as 'the new team.' He offers an 'honorable discharge' and fires a ray that drains {player} and {teammate} of their powers. The recruits keep theirs. As the clones close in, the recruits hold them off while the two run for the exit.

14:f466ez.text: The Agent finds them, thanks the team, and tells them they're no longer needed: clones of himself step out of the tanks as 'the new team.' He offers an 'honorable discharge' and fires a ray that drains {player} and {teammate} of their powers. With no one else to help, the two run for the exit as the clones give chase.

15:1570bzw.text: The team hides in the sewers under the Lab, where the recruits are sure the Agent will never look. {player} and {teammate} are powerless, but the recruits are still empowered: the ray didn't work on them. {player} wants to touch Kaiju parts to get powers back; {teammate} warns how the radiation has scrambled the recruits' minds, and who knows what else it does. {player} insists they can't leave the city to the Agent. Then a doorway starts to glow.

15:bhzfzz.text: {player} and {teammate} hide in the sewers under the Lab, powerless and alone. {player} wants to get their powers back by touching Kaiju parts; {teammate} is unsure, but {player} insists they can't leave the city to the Agent. Then a doorway starts to glow.

16:uc6jpf.text: Through the glowing door, the sewer is full of Kaiju parts: Lab specimens, flushed once the scientists were done with them. There's no taking back what they'll do. {player} and {teammate} remember how they've always had each other's backs, they are in it together, even now, and they touch the parts. White light. 'Mr. Agent Man, we're coming for you.'

17:d9urq5.text: Back in the Lab, the Agent laughs at the team's new glow: Kaiju powers are unstable, and they take the mind, the body, or both. Every Kaiju the team has fought was once a soldier or citizen, his failed experiments. He calls his Agents to finish them before they turn. The team beats the clones, but {teammate}'s hands begin to burn, and {teammate:he} pulls away from {player}.

18:1agf3pb.text: The Agent and his clones are dead, but the radar shows every Kaiju left in the sea coming at once. In the last fight on the Peninsula, {teammate} admits to feeling strange. When the last Kaiju falls, {teammate} can still hear their roars, and turns into a Kaiju bent on destroying the city. Every recruit still standing turns with {teammate:him}. {player} turns too, but keeps {you:his} mind: {you:his} last act as the city's defender is to stop {you:his} teammate. If {teammate} has already fallen, {player} hears the roars alone, turns, and the city is destroyed.

19:1e2zgfh.section: Visiting a battleground (any map walk, after its fight)
19:1e2zgfh.text: A won battleground, revisited, is quiet: a place to train. A recruit found there offers to teach their power in a one-on-one fight. Where the bystander was terminated, {teammate} offers to spar instead, so they can both get tougher.
